messages:
ana: Quick heads-up - ran a microingest perf audit after the kernel-routing change. Seeing p95 tail increase (~8-12%) for short streaming requests over HTTP/gRPC. Root cause unknown, posting traces for triage.

mike: What workload did you run? qps, tokens, concurrency?

ana: workload: 1k qps, 128-token avg, concurrency 80, two regions. Both http1 streaming and grpc streaming show same trend.

devon: Did the kernel picker PR change batching hints? I recall a threshold tweak for mini-batches.

ana: yes - kernel-routing prefers small-kernel for seq <96 unless kv_cache_hit_rate > 0.7. Might be oscillation with kv heuristics.

sarah: If KV hit detection is noisy, we could be flipping kernels mid-stream which adds tokenization/parse overhead. Any increase in tokenizer sys CPU?

kelsey: Flame I pulled from host-12: parse_request 42.1%, tokenizer 21.3%, grpc_write 8.7%, http_parser 6.2%, kv_cache_lookup 4.1%, other 17.6%. Tokenizer+parse jumped ~+20% vs baseline.

mike: Small-kernel path might reduce continuous batching window, increasing parse cycles per token. Check batching window histograms.

devon: Traces show many kernel-switch events in the hot path. Router flips after first chunk because kv hit estimate updates.

perf-bot: Regression alert: 6234567000..6234567800 host-ingress p95 +9.4% (deploy 2026-03-22T10:12Z) - https://perf.redwood.local/runs/6234

sarah: Two mitigations: 1) pin kernel per-request at ingress based on initial estimate, or 2) delay switching until chunk boundary where kv estimate stabilizes. Pinning is simplest for canary.

kelsey: Repro: `make perf-run WORKERS=80 QPS=1000 TOKENS=128 -run microingest-kernel-test` - includes http/grpc toggles.

mike: I vote pin per-request in 1.2 release, follow-up with smarter heuristics to avoid oscillation.

devon: I'll open PR to set request-scoped kernel_hint on ingress and add metric `kernel_switches_per_req`. Will run canary tomorrow.

ana: Assigning: devon -> PR & canary, kelsey -> reproduce script & flame, sarah -> design for delayed switch, mike -> rollout plan.

sarah: Also capture per-chunk kv hit traces (sample 1%) so we can validate the hit-rate estimator.

kelsey: On it, pushing sampling and dumping to perf-bucket.

ana: If canary looks good we can revert or stabilize the heuristic tweak. Thanks all :thumbsup:
